# Anti-Money-Laundering Overview

This wiki page explains how [[Structuring]] and [[Layering]] appear across cases.
See §2 for the typology and https://example.org/fatf for the source guidance.

## Typology

Structuring: breaking a large transfer into many small deposits to avoid reporting
thresholds. Layering: moving funds through several accounts to obscure their origin.

Beneficial Owner: the natural person who ultimately controls an account, per [1].
